title: Aquatick
subtitle: Hydration tracker with a personal daily goal, heat-map history, charts and a Wear OS companion app.

sections.description: Aquatick works out your daily water goal from your profile, lets you log drinks from the phone or your watch, and shows your progress as a heat-map calendar with a day timeline and charts. Reminders keep you on track through the day.
features: Daily goal calculated from gender, weight, height and activity level
Log drinks by type, with undo and remove
Heat-map history calendar with a per-day timeline
Analysis tab with bar charts (Vico) and stat tiles
Wear OS app that syncs drinks between watch and phone
Reminder notifications and unit settings applied app-wide
Sign-in and data storage with Supabase
Midnight Tide design system shared by phone and watch
